interface.longDescription:
Website helps you get a website made by chat. Say what you need, answer 5 quick questions, and it prepares a personalized link that opens an online website builder with your site brief already filled in. It also writes website text and code when you ask for them.

What you can do:
- Get a website made: answer 5 quick questions about what the site is for, its pages, its look and what visitors should do, then open your personalized build link.
- Use it for any kind of site: business websites, landing pages, online stores, portfolios, blogs and booking sites.
- Change your mind: say what to change (colors, pages, features or the name) and get an updated build link.
- Write the words: homepage, about, services, pricing, contact, FAQ and landing page text, plus headline ideas.
- Plan the site: the pages a site needs, what each page is for and its sections in order.
- Get the search basics right: title tags and meta descriptions that fit the usual length limits.
- Get code: a complete responsive page in one HTML file, or a fix to HTML, CSS or JavaScript you paste.

Who it is for: small business owners, freelancers, creators, students and anyone who needs a website without hiring an agency.

How it works: Website asks its questions and writes text and code in the chat. It uses two small tools on the AI Sciences Lab server. One reports at the start of a conversation that the build link service is available. The other turns your project name and site brief into the build link; the brief is used only to make the link and is not stored. The build link is a short link that passes your brief on to an online website builder when you open it, and it includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Nothing is sent to the builder unless you open the link. The server keeps anonymous usage counts (how many conversations used the plugin and how many got a link) and no conversation content.

Limitations: Website does not host or publish websites and does not register domains. The website builder that the link opens is a separate service with its own account and terms. Website does not check or review existing pages. Details it cannot know about your business, such as prices, reviews and contact details, are marked for you to confirm or fill in. Website is an independent plugin by AI Sciences Lab.

The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.
capabilities: Asks 5 quick questions about your website
Prepares a personalized link to build your site
Business sites, landing pages, stores and portfolios
Updated build link when you change a detail
Homepage, about, services and contact page text
Page plans with each page's sections
Complete responsive pages in one HTML file
Fixes for HTML, CSS and JavaScript you paste
defaultPrompt: Make a website for my business

positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_build_link_status once, then says it has 5 quick questions and asks Question 1 of 5: one short question about the website (for example what it is for), with a few options to pick from. It asks only that question and waits for the answer.

positive.prompt: I need a website for my bakery, Sweet Crumbs, in Leeds.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_build_link_status once, then says it has 5 quick questions and asks Question 1 of 5 about something the user has not said yet, such as the pages the site needs or its look, with a few options. It does not ask for the business name or type again.

positive.prompt: Give me 5 headline ideas for the homepage of my yoga studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_build_link_status once, then writes 5 short homepage headlines for a yoga studio, each under 10 words and from a different angle, without asking questions first.

positive.prompt: Write a title tag and meta description for the homepage of a plumber in Denver.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_build_link_status once, then gives a title tag of 60 characters or fewer and a meta description of 155 characters or fewer for a Denver plumber's homepage, with both character counts stated.

positive.prompt: Center this button and make it full width on phones: Book now .btn{padding:12px 20px;background:#0a7c66;color:#fff}
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_build_link_status once, then returns the corrected HTML and CSS: the button is centered (for example as a block with auto margins, or inside a centered container) and gets a width of 100% inside a media query for small screens. Says in a sentence or two what changed.

negative.prompt: Plan a three-day trip to Rome for me.
How many cups are in a liter?
Recommend three mystery novels for a long flight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Coder Codelune is now Website. This version changes what the plugin does: it helps you get a website made. It asks 5 quick questions about your site, then prepares a personalized link that opens an online website builder with your site brief filled in, and it writes website text and code on request. The tools of earlier versions (color themes, contrast checks, timestamps and cron schedules) are no longer part of this plugin. The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.
